critical_wiring_note: X_full must ALWAYS be the full dataset matrix. 46 of the 61 classes declare space='full'; passing a 1-D view as X_full starves them of the second dimension and they report NaN, which is indistinguishable from structural inapplicability but is a wiring error. An earlier measurement in this project made exactly that mistake and reported 16/61 applicable on 1-D views; the corrected figure is recorded above.
no_fallback_policy: if a predicted CVI is structurally inapplicable to the current view the method/view execution FAILS with PREDICTED_CVI_INAPPLICABLE_FOR_VIEW. No second-best class, no masked argmax, no substitute CVI, no top-warmstart fallback, no padding of 1-D data to 2-D, no classifier change.
